name: Lina Ristorante
notes: Opened November 2025. Chef Bia Limoni + Felipe Bronze (Bronze+ accelerator). First project. Rua Jerônimo da Veiga, 129. Reservations via GetIn app. ~80 covers.

name: Marena Cucina
notes: Opened December 2024 / early 2025. Pugliese cuisine, artisanal burratas, stone walls, garden. Rua Pais de Araújo, 138. 120 covers. WhatsApp reservations: (11) 91462-2852. Michelin Guide listed.

name: Gianni Restaurante
notes: Opened August 2025. Same group as Il Capitale and Fiaschetteria del Capitale (Gianluca Perino + chef Ricardo Dicamargo). Av. Horácio Lafer, 225 / corner Av. Brig. Faria Lima, 3555. 80 covers. Glass-enclosed space with marble and wood.

name: Assador SP
notes: São Paulo expansion from Rio de Janeiro. Same group as Corrientes 348. Av. Brig. Faria Lima, 3732, Itaim Bibi. 20+ cuts including dry-aged alcatra. Mon–Sat 12h–23h, Sun 12h–21h. Rodízio R$256.

name: Le Bulô
notes: Opened 2024. Fish and seafood with a carioca/French influence. Rua Manuel Guedes, 233, Itaim Bibi. WhatsApp (11) 95300-3435. Tue–Sat 12h–16h and 19h–23h, Sun 12h–17h.

name: Bar Europa
notes: Neighborhood bar with Italian soul. Individual pizzas from a gas Italian oven. Alameda Gabriel Monteiro da Silva, 1333, Jardim Paulistano. Mon–Tue 12h–15h/18h–23h, Wed–Sat 12h–23h, Sun 12h–22h.

name: Sová
notes: Jewish restaurant + artisanal bakery. Sephardic, Ashkenazi, and New York diaspora influences. Alameda Jaú, 1494, Jardim Paulista. Tue–Sun 8h–22h. Babka, bagels, Leicaj de mel.

name: Mimada Café
notes: Brunch café by chef Renata Vanzetto. Part of her gastronomic complex. Rua Bela Cintra, 1543, Jardins. Opened late 2025.

name: Chiisai Izakaya
notes: Only 30 seats. Chef Alexandre Saber. Robata and izakaya-style dishes by chef Wilson Kinoshita, cocktails by mixologist Ricardo Takahashi. Alameda Franca, 149, Jardins. Intimate boteco format.

name: Song Qi São Paulo
notes: First branch outside Monaco. Co-owner Felipe Massa. Rua Barão de Capanema, 348, Jardins / Cerqueira César. Online reservation via Tagme. Open daily 12h–00h30 (Thu from 18h). High-end Chinese dining.

name: Miyabi
notes: 15-course gluten-free omakase, R$700. Sake pairing R$330. Rua Marcos Azevedo, 86, Pinheiros. Tue–Sat 19h–23h. Opened mid-2025. Specialty: Japanese technique + Brazilian ingredients, no gluten whatsoever.

name: Lena
notes: Chef Mário Santiago's first São Paulo restaurant. 'Onde Minas encontra o mundo.' R. Dr. Virgílio de Carvalho Pinto, 98, Pinheiros. Tue–Fri 11h30–16h30, Sat 9h30–16h, Sun 12h30–16h30. Veja Comer & Beber 2025 pick.

name: Tortuga Restaurante
notes: First location outside Spain for chef Pedro Gonzalez (4 years in Barcelona). Rua Padre Carvalho, 171, Pinheiros. Mon 19h–23h, Tue–Sat 12h–15h30 / 19h–23h, Sun 12h–17h. Groups 6+ WhatsApp: (11) 96191-2225.

name: Osteria Caco
notes: Chef Victor Senna. Predominantly Italian with French touches and family recipe influences. Rua Artur de Azevedo, 496, Pinheiros. Tue–Thu 19h–22h, Fri 19h–23h, Sat 12h–16h/19h–23h, Sun 12h–16h.

name: Mares de la Peruana
notes: Chef Marisabel Woodman (of La Peruana). Focused on fish and seafood with creative freedom. Rua Ferreira de Araújo, 299, Pinheiros. Sister concept to La Peruana.

name: Trattorita Evvai
notes: Casual offshoot of Michelin-starred Evvai. Rua Joaquim Antunes, 260, Pinheiros. Tue–Sun (pizza Sunday dinner only). Michelin Guide listed.

name: Broca
notes: Chef Cadu Evangelisti (Top Chef Brasil 2021 runner-up). Rua Aspicuelta, 429, Vila Madalena. Open kitchen, arborized courtyard. Tue–Sat 12h–23h30, Sun 12h–18h. Reservations via GetIn app.

name: Joya Boulangerie
notes: Chef Isabela Honda + Marisol Piccoli. 95 covers, market area, production rooms. Rua Fradique Coutinho, 1406, Vila Madalena. Tue–Sat 8h–22h, Sun 8h–15h. Veja Comer & Beber 2025 highlight.

name: Casa do Saulo SP
notes: Chef Saulo Jennings. São Paulo branch of the celebrated Pará restaurant. Rua Gomes de Carvalho, 1666, Vila Olímpia. Mon–Fri 11h30–15h/19h–23h, Sat 12h–16h/19h–23h, Sun 12h–17h.

name: BASQ
notes: Chef Gustavo Série. Basque cuisine: pintxos, wagyu, Basque burnt cheesecake, grilled dishes. Rua Normandia, 17, Moema. Soft opening December 5 2025, official opening January 2 2026.

name: Imma Restaurante
notes: Chef Marcelo Giachini. Iberian-inspired with Mediterranean touches. Rua Emanuel Kant, 58, Jardim Europa. Tue–Fri 12h–15h/19h–23h, Sat 12h–23h, Sun 12h–16h. Also (11) 3064-6250.

name: Metzi
notes: Latin America's 50 Best 2024 #27. Michelin Guide. Rua João Moura, 861, Pinheiros. Reservations via website. No public email found — contact via site contact form.

name: Kinoshita
notes: 1 Michelin star 2025. Rua Jacques Félix, 405, Vila Nova Conceição. Reservations via Tagme widget. WhatsApp (11) 95318-5978. No public email found — reservations by phone/WhatsApp.

name: Koshô
notes: Rua Marcos Lopes, 121, Vila Nova Conceição. WhatsApp (11) 91021-5839. Contact form at kosho.com.br/contato. No public email found.

name: By Koji
notes: Two locations: Vila Nova Conceição and Morumbi Stadium (Gate 17) / Albert Einstein Hospital. Tue–Fri 12h–15h/19h–23h30, Sat 12h–16h/19h–23h30, Sun 12h–16h/19h–22h.

name: Osso
notes: Michelin Guide listed. Veja Comer & Beber best meat São Paulo. Rua Bandeira Paulista, 520, Itaim Bibi. Reservations via Tagme widget. No public email found.

name: Barbacoa
notes: Since 1990. Multiple SP locations. Main: R. Dr. Renato Paes de Barros, 65, Itaim Bibi. Also D&D Shopping (11) 3043-9244 and Morumbi (11) 5181-6898. Online reservations via Tagme. No public email found — groups via phone.

name: Atto Restaurante
notes: Chef Luiza Hoffmann. Historic mansion (former home of actress Cacilda Becker). Rua Pais de Araújo, 138, Itaim Bibi. Reservations: (11) 94810-0000. Tue–Thu 12h–15h/18h–23h, Fri–Sat 12h–23h30, Sun 12h–19h. Closed Mon.

name: Sallvattore
notes: R. Salvador Cardoso, 131, Itaim Bibi. Reservations by WhatsApp or phone until 12:30 (lunch) and 19:40 (dinner). No public email found — contact via WhatsApp.

name: Freddy
notes: Traditional French restaurant. Rua Pedroso Alvarenga, 1170, Itaim Bibi. Mon–Fri 12h–15h/19h–00h, Sat 19h–00h, Sun 12h–17h. WhatsApp: (11) 97450-9635. Valor Cultural certificate (historic institution). No public email found.

name: Goya Zushi
notes: Chef Uilian Goya. Michelin Guide listed. Rua Artur Frazão, 37 (also listed as Alameda Franca, 1151), Jardins / Jardim Paulista. Tue–Sat omakase only. No public email found — WhatsApp only.

name: Picchi
notes: Michelin Guide listed. Chef Pier Paolo Picchi. Ground floor of Regent Park hotel. Rua Oscar Freire, 533, Jardins. Tue–Sun lunch 12h–15h, Tue–Sat dinner 19h–22h. WhatsApp (11) 99448-9575.

name: Pasquale Cantina
notes: Since 2001. Rua Girassol, 66, Vila Madalena. Mon–Sat 12h–00h. Pasta, antipasti. No public email found — contact by phone.

name: Tanuki Sushi
notes: 21 years in Vila Madalena. Traditional Japanese in a small, welcoming environment. Rua Jericó, 287, Sumarezinho. Pinheiros / Vila Madalena area.

name: Kubo Zushi
notes: Michelin Guide listed. Rua das Tabocas, 158, Vila Madalena. Mon–Sat lunch 12h–15h, dinner 19h–23h. WhatsApp (11) 94388-8866. Email found via press/contact inquiry.

name: Bosco Restaurante
notes: 1940s mansion with 80-year-old jabuticaba trees through the ceiling/glass wall. Chef Natalia Ebone. Artisanal pasta and pizza with Italian flour and long fermentation. Rua João Moura, 976, Pinheiros. Tue–Fri 12h–15h/18h30–23h, Sat 12h–23h, Sun 12h–17h. No reservations after 12:15 lunch / 19h dinner. Front bar (11–23 people) via WhatsApp. No public email found.

name: Cór Gastronomia
notes: Peruvian-inspired dry-aged meats. Chef Renzo Garibaldi. Praça São Marcos, 825, Alto de Pinheiros. Mon 12h–15h, Tue–Thu 12h–15h/18h–23h, Fri–Sat 12h–00h, Sun 12h–18h. Also (11) 3021-2399. No public email found.
